integrity: The proof is reconstructed from the published finite presentation and an exact symbolic factorization certificate; no numerical experiment is used as proof. The source presentation and its hypotheses were independently reread from the primary full text.
scientific_limitations: The statement assumes \(q^4\neq1\) and \(q^6\neq1\), does not cover those exceptional roots of unity, and does not assert pairwise distinctness of the ten displayed formula-points for every allowed \(q\).
title: One-dimensional characters of the generic once-punctured-torus PGL2 skein algebra
